articles.title: Ted Lasso is Back! But This Time He's Coaching a Women's Team
articles.summary: Ted Lasso returns to coach a women's soccer team in England. The new season starts August 5 on Apple TV, with 10 episodes full of laughs and familiar faces.

articles.title: Why Are Killer Whales Still Bumping Boats? A New Sinking Off Spain
articles.summary: Orcas sank another boat near Spain, the eighth since 2020. Scientists think young whales are copying each other, not seeking revenge. Sailors are told to stop their engines and let go of the wheel.

articles.title: Did Anyone Survive the Pompeii Volcano? A New Show Hunts for Clues
articles.summary: Actor Tom Hiddleston explores whether three real people escaped the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 CE. The documentary mixes science and imagination to follow a teen, a businesswoman, and a soldier.
